hero.title: Reliable Metal Packaging Solutions for Food Industry
hero.description: We provide high-quality metal packaging solutions that meet food safety and durability standards, suitable for the food and beverage industry.

about.subtitle: ABOUT US
about.title: DELTA SEIKAN OVERVIEW
about.desc1: Established in 2020, delta seikan is manufacturer of metal packaging for the food, beverage.
about.desc2: With the motto of considering the customer as the center of perfection, the products following to the philosophy of simplicity but sophistication will meet the high demand of domestic and foreign markets.
about.desc3: And aims to become the leading manufacturer of metal packaging for the food industry  in VIỆT NAM.

features.title: VISION - MISSION - VALUES
features.visionDesc: Becoming the leading manufacturer of metal packaging for the food industry in VIỆT NAM.
features.missionDesc: Offering reliable and sustainable solutions to improve quality and service.

capability.title: PRODUCTION
capability.r1Desc: Carry out research, development and testing the product to meet market needs, improve quality and efficiency of product.
capability.r2Desc: Providing the best quality products to customer with optimized production and management system.
capability.r3Desc: We always commit that all products are checked to meet the signed quality standard and comply with food safety management system FSSC22000 before delivering to customer.
capability.r4Desc: Regarding sales activities, we always effort to uncover consumer needs and developing new markets, providing feedback to R&D team to catch up market trends to create products with the best quality and competitive price.

timeline.title: DEVELOPMENT HISTORY
timeline.y2020Desc: Officially commenced operations with a vision to become a leader in the metal packaging industry.
timeline.y2021Desc: Successfully introduced an advanced DRD can production line to the market.
timeline.y2022Desc: Achieved ISO 9001:2015 and HACCP certifications, ensuring quality and food safety standards.
timeline.y2023Desc: Obtained FSSC 22000 certification, reinforcing compliance with international food safety systems.
